Bun 使用官方发布的二进制文件。复杂安装环境可通过全局配置中的 install: Bun uses its official binaries. Set install_env in the global config for advanced installation environments.
自定义 Deno 安装的全局脚本目录。: Set the directory for globally installed Deno scripts.
留空安装 SDK。windowsdesktop 适用于 Windows 桌面应用: Leave blank to install the SDK. Choose windowsdesktop for Windows desktop applications.
用于查询 dotnet 全局工具版本的 NuGet 服务索引。: NuGet service index used to look up .NET global tool versions.
为每个 SDK 版本使用独立目录。: Use a separate directory for each SDK version.
指定多个 .NET SDK 版本共同使用的安装目录。: Installation directory shared by multiple .NET SDK versions.
为不同 Elixir 版本指定共享的 Mix 数据目录。: Mix data directory shared across Elixir versions.
覆盖 Mix 查找归档的目录。: Override where Mix looks for archives.
请选择与 Erlang/OTP 版本兼容的 Elixir。: Choose an Elixir version compatible with your Erlang/OTP version.
需要支持 kerl 的平台和构建工具。原生 Windows 安装通常使用预编译包: Requires a platform with kerl support and build tools. Native Windows normally uses prebuilt packages.
仅适用于 Linux 的 Ubuntu 预编译包。: Applies to prebuilt Ubuntu packages on Linux only.
源码编译时可在全局配置的 install_env 中设置 KERL_CONFIG: For source builds, set KERL_CONFIGURE_OPTIONS in install_env in the global config.
镜像需提供 Go 安装包及对应的 SHA-256 文件。: The mirror must provide Go packages and their SHA-256 checksums.
mise 查询 Go 版本所用的 Git 仓库。: Git repository that mise uses to look up Go versions.
依赖下载使用的 GOPROXY。可填写逗号分隔的回退列表。: GOPROXY for module downloads. Accepts a comma-separated fallback list.
使 go install 的输出跟随已激活的 Go 版本。: Place go install output under the active Go version.
将 GOROOT 指向当前 Go 安装。: Point GOROOT at the active Go installation.
ga 为正式版，ea 为早期访问版。: ga is general availability, ea is early access.
为 java@21 这类未指定发行版的版本请求选择供应商，例如 temurin: Choose a vendor such as temurin or openjdk for unqualified versions like java@21.
镜像需提供 Node.js 安装包及 SHASUMS256.txt。: The mirror must provide Node.js packages and SHASUMS256.txt.
npm 安装依赖时使用的仓库。: Registry used by npm to install dependencies.
安装 Node.js 后运行 corepack enable。: Run corepack enable after installing Node.js.
全局安装 npm 工具后重新生成 shims。: Regenerate shims after installing global npm packages.
覆盖使用预编译包的默认行为。需要系统编译工具。: Override the prebuilt package default. Requires system build tools.
指定 Linux 预编译包类型，例如 musl。: Select a prebuilt Linux flavor such as musl.
仅用于 Unix 预编译 Python。通常保留 mise 默认行为。: Applies to prebuilt Python on Unix. Usually leave this at the mise default.
pip 用于下载 Python 依赖的索引。: Index used by pip to download Python dependencies.
mise 获取 python-build 的 pyenv Git 仓库地址。: pyenv Git repository that mise uses to fetch python-build.
覆盖预编译架构，例如 x86_64_v3 或 aarch64。: Override the prebuilt architecture, such as x86_64_v3 or aarch64.
覆盖预编译包的平台标识。: Override the prebuilt package platform identifier.
为 mise 的 _.python.venv 设置优先使用 Python 标准库: Prefer Python's standard library for the mise _.python.venv setting.
支持 owner/repo 或 URL 模板。Windows 上由 RubyIn: Accepts owner/repo or a URL template. RubyInstaller2 provides Windows builds.
源码构建使用的 Git 仓库或 ZIP 文件地址。: Git repository or ZIP URL used for source builds.
传给 Ruby configure 的参数，例如 --enable-yjit。: Arguments passed to Ruby configure, such as --enable-yjit.
传给 ruby-build 自身的参数，例如 --keep。: Arguments passed to ruby-build itself, such as --keep.
覆盖预编译包选择；原生 Windows 使用 RubyInstaller2。: Override prebuilt selection. Native Windows uses RubyInstaller2.
minimal 仅安装核心工具。complete 可能包含当前版本无法安装的组件: minimal installs core tools only. complete can include components unavailable for the selected version.
填写组件名，多个以英文逗号分隔，例如 rust-src,llvm-tools。: Enter component names separated by commas, for example rust-src,llvm-tools.
填写目标三元组，多个以英文逗号分隔，例如 wasm32-unknown-unkn: Enter target triples separated by commas, for example wasm32-unknown-unknown.
通过 mr-boxington 共享 Cargo 构建缓存，需要同时安装它。: Share Cargo's build cache through mr-boxington, which must also be installed.
Rustup 的工具链下载地址，例如 https://rsproxy.cn。: Rustup toolchain download URL, for example https://rsproxy.cn.
Base URL for rustup-init downloads, for example https://rsproxy.cn/rustup.
传给 rustup-init 的默认主机平台，例如 x86_64-pc-wind: Default host passed to rustup-init, for example x86_64-pc-windows-msvc.
覆盖 mise 管理的 Rust 工具链所用的 RUSTUP_HOME。: Override RUSTUP_HOME for mise-managed Rust toolchains.
覆盖 mise 管理的 Rust 工具链所用的 CARGO_HOME。: Override CARGO_HOME for mise-managed Rust toolchains.
Cargo 依赖镜像单独写入 Cargo 配置。: The Cargo dependency mirror is written to Cargo's separate config.
指定 Linux 发行版的 Swift 构建，例如 ubuntu24.04。: Choose a Swift build for a Linux distribution, such as ubuntu24.04.
mise 的 Swift 核心后端支持 macOS 和 Linux。可为这些平台: The mise core Swift backend supports macOS and Linux. You can prepare configuration for those platforms here.
先尝试 ziglang.org 推荐的社区下载镜像。: Try the community download mirrors recommended by ziglang.org first.
由 mise 在安装该工具后运行。: Run by mise after installing this tool.
等待版本发布一段时间再安装，例如 3d。: Wait for a release to reach this age before installing, for example 3d.
运行这个工具的命令时再安装。: Install this tool the first time a command uses it.
仅在全局配置中生效。: Applies only in the global config.
关闭后，mise upgrade --bump 会保留现有版本要求。: Disable to preserve this version request when running mise upgrade --bump.
将预发行版本纳入版本选择，支持情况取决于后端。: Include prereleases when selecting versions on supporting backends.
例如 stable、beta、nightly 或 1.88.0。留空时由 mis: For example, stable, beta, nightly, or 1.88.0. Leave blank to let mise choose.
留空时由 mise 选择。: Leave blank to let mise choose.
例如 sparse+https://rsproxy.cn/index/。用于当前: For example, sparse+https://rsproxy.cn/index/. Applies to this workspace and preserves manual configuration.
仅保存改动的非空项，设置会应用于当前便携工作区。: Save changed, nonempty fields to this portable workspace.
安装 mise 后，且没有任务运行时可修改。: Available once mise is installed and no task is running.
工作区设置须填写在同一行。: Use a single line for each workspace setting.
Cargo 会优先读取已有的 config 文件。请在「配置与维护」中检查该文件: Cargo will read the existing config file first. Check it in Configuration and maintenance.
已有其他 CARGO_HOME 设置，请先在 mise 配置中处理该设置。: CARGO_HOME already points elsewhere. Review that setting in the mise config first.
未完成保存，且无法恢复原 mise 配置。请检查 config.toml。: Saving failed and the original mise config could not be restored. Check config.toml.
请输入不含账号、查询参数或片段的 HTTP(S) 镜像地址。: Enter an HTTP or HTTPS mirror URL without credentials, a query, or a fragment.
mise 配置命令退出码为 {0}。: The mise configuration command exited with code {0}.
Cargo 配置已有依赖源，请在「配置与维护」中手动编辑。: Cargo already has a dependency source. Edit it manually in Configuration and maintenance.
现有 Cargo 镜像已手动编辑，请在「配置与维护」中编辑。: The Cargo mirror was edited manually. Change it in Configuration and maintenance.
无法在当前配置中设置 Cargo 镜像。: The Cargo mirror could not be applied to the current config.
无法解析已有 Cargo 配置，原文件已保留。: Could not read the current Cargo config. The original file was preserved.
配置文件在编辑期间发生了变化，请重新打开设置。: The configuration file changed while it was open. Reopen the settings and try again.
